<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that correspond to a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition. In the forward reaction, two C=C bonds of a diene and one C=C bond of a dienophile become single C‑C bonds, while one C=C bond remains in the cyclohexene product. Therefore, the bond‑order change is “C=C (2.0→1.0)”. I will search for templates that have this bond‑order change for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
